title: Spider-Man
tagline: A tie-in to the Raimi film, with extra street missions.
summary: Treyarch’s tie-in follows the 2002 film’s Green Goblin story and adds missions that are not in the movie. It uses the film’s Peter Parker. It is an adaptation, not a new scene from the film.
gameplay: Third-person web swinging across a limited outdoor New York, with combat levels built around the film’s set pieces.
